senses.gloss:
vaidarbha, f. -ī, a. belonging to Vidarbha;
 as m. the Vidarbhan, i. e. king of
V.; as f. the princess of V., i. e. Damayantī,
 8^7, etc. [vidarbha, 1208f.]

vaidika, a. Vedic, prescribed by or conformable
to the Vedas. [veda, 1222e 2.]

vaidyá,
 —1. a. having to do with science,
learned; and so
 —2. as m. (with a transition
[]
like that from Lat. doctor, ‘teacher,
learned man,’ to Chaucer's doctour of
phisik) physician, doctor. [vidyā́, 1211.]
